title: GrantThai source entry (one item of project.yaml `sources`)
description: Draft. The project's own source registry. A field record's `source_ids` entry is RESOLVABLE when it names exactly one entry here and that entry passes the offline checks in spec/common/links-and-sources.md. GrantThai never fetches `url` (no network, ever); a URL is recorded for the human reader only.

source_id.description: Unique within project.yaml, e.g. SRC-1 or SRC-SURVEY-2025.

kind.description: Same vocabulary as provenance source_type, minus AI_TRANSLATION_PROPOSAL (an AI proposal is never a source).

citation.description: Human-readable reference: enough for another person to find the source without GrantThai.

locator.description: Page, section, table or timestamp inside the source.

url.description: Recorded, never fetched or checked for reachability.

file.description: Optional local copy, as a path relative to the directory that contains project.yaml. When present it must exist (offline check).

sha256.description: Optional. When `file` is present too, the file's sha256 must equal this value.

contains_personal_data.description: True for interview notes, lived-experience accounts and anything else naming or identifying a person. The output source manifest then prints only source_id, kind and '[private]'.
